blocks.caption: Generate and test ke faide aur nuqsanaat
rows: Saadgi: saade masail ke liye samajhna aur banana aasan
Na-kaarkardagi: bari gunjaish mein bohat se umeedwar jaanchne parte hain
Har fan mola: bohat se masail par chalta hai jin ki saaf hikmat-e-amli na ho
Behtareen ki zamanat nahi: durust hal deta hai, zaroori nahi behtareen
Mukammaliyat: tamam hal dekhta hai, koi nazar-andaz nahi hota
Computational kharcha: umeedwar be-shumar hon to na-qabil-e-amal

blocks.text: Generate and test aksar artificial intelligence mein istemal hota hai, jaise games khelna, jahan behtareen tareeqa mukhtalif imkanaat aazmana hai jab tak koi chal jaye (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Generate and test behtareen hal kyun chhor sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh test paas karne wale pehle umeedwar par ruk jata hai, jo durust ho sakta hai magar behtareen nahi.

items: Faide: saada, har fan mola, mukammal. Nuqsanaat: na-kaarkard, behtareen ki zamanat nahi, mehnga.
